# foreman_katello_content_view (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_katello_content_view" "epel8_cv" {
  name = "EPEL 8 Content View"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the katello content view to look up.

### Read-Only

- `auto_publish` (Boolean) Auto publish composite view
- `composite` (Boolean) Composite content view
- `content_host_count` (Number) Content host count
- `description` (String) Description of the content view
- `filtered` (Boolean) Content view has filters
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `label` (String) Label of the content view
- `latest_version` (String) Latest version
- `latest_version_id` (Number) Latest version ID
- `organization_id` (Number) Organization ID
- `solve_dependencies` (Boolean) Solve dependencies
- `version_count` (Number) Version count
